snippet.title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Billy is back for an investigative adventure in Summer camp.
Unravel mysterious events in this colorful journey as campers’ worries manifest as Fearlings. Explore the camp, investigate its secrets, and confront those fears through clever puzzles.
